name: King Lot
one_line: One of the kings who fought Arthur, and the father of the house that will bring him down.
dossier: Lot leads the rebellion of the eleven kings against the boy king, is defeated, and is later killed by King Pellinore. His sons — Gawain, Agravaine, Gaheris and Gareth — become the strongest and most dangerous bloc in the Round Table, and their feud with Pellinore's line, which produces Lamorak's murder, is a private war running under the whole book.
